Răspunsuri la cele mai comune întrebări: Answers to the most common questions about orders, shipping, returns and payment.
Cum plasez o comandă?: How do I place an order?
Alege produsul dorit, selectează mărimea: Choose the product you want, select the size and colour, then add it to your cart. At checkout you fill in your delivery and payment details, and right after confirmation you'll receive an email with the order summary and tracking details.
Pot modifica sau anula o comandă?: Can I change or cancel an order?
Da, atâta timp cât comanda nu a fost înc: Yes, as long as the order hasn't shipped yet. Contact us as soon as possible with your order number handy, and we'll make the change or cancellation. After shipping, you can use the return policy.
Cum urmăresc statusul comenzii?: How do I track my order status?
După expediere primești pe email codul A: After shipping you'll receive the AWB code and a tracking link by email. You can also check the status anytime from your account, under My Orders.
Comenzile sunt procesate în 1–2 zile luc: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days, and the parcel usually arrives within 3–5 business days at your address or chosen pickup point.
Costul de livrare se calculează automat: The shipping cost is calculated automatically at checkout, depending on the method chosen. The exact rate is shown before you place the order.
Da, livrăm în toată țara prin curier rap: Yes, we deliver nationwide by express courier, both to your address and to available pickup points.
Poți returna produsele în termen de 14 z: You can return products within 14 days of receiving them, without needing to justify your decision. Products must be unworn, with tags attached, and in their original packaging.
Cât durează rambursarea banilor?: How long does the refund take?
După ce primim și verificăm produsul ret: Once we receive and verify the returned product, we refund its value within a maximum of 14 days, using the same payment method you used for the order.
Cum schimb mărimea unui produs?: How do I exchange a product for a different size?
Contactează-ne și îți spunem pașii pentr: Contact us and we'll tell you the steps for a size exchange, subject to available stock. If the size you want is no longer available, we offer a full refund.
Ce metode de plată acceptați?: What payment methods do you accept?
Acceptăm plata online securizată cu card: We accept secure online payment by card (Visa, Mastercard). Transactions are processed by an authorised payment provider, with 3D Secure protection.
Da Datele cardului sunt criptate și proc: Yes. Card details are encrypted and processed directly by the payment provider over a secure connection. They are not stored on our site and we have no access to them.
Primesc factură pentru comandă?: Will I receive an invoice for my order?
Da, pentru fiecare comandă emitem factur: Yes, we issue an invoice for every order, which you receive by email together with the order confirmation.
Scrie-ne și te ajutăm cu plăcere: Message us and we'll gladly help.
